snippet.title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management game where no two winters are the same. Paint trails onto real mountains, connect lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

Play the demo now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4493130/SkiEO_Ski_Resort_Tycoon/
